questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: The Western Ghats run parallel to which coast of India?
questions.explanation: The Western Ghats run along the western coast.

questions.question: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: The idea of a Preamble was borrowed from the US Constitution.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar"?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to flooding.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.explanation: Multiples: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Sum = 60. Average = 60/5 = 12.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 84. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 84/7 = 12. Larger = 5 × 12 = 60.

questions.question: A train 160 m long crosses a pole in 8 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/30 = 50/600. Time = 600/50 = 12 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √256.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹450. Find its marked price.
Find 50% of 20% of 1200.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 8 and their difference is 25. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 5 parts = 25, so each part = 5. Smaller = 3 × 5 = 15.

questions.question: A boat travels 26 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 26/2 = 13 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 13 − 1 = 12 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 12 days?
questions.explanation: 12 mod 7 = 5; Friday + 5 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 10th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 10th letter = J; 10 + 4 = 14th letter = N.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (4, 64), (7, 343), (8, 512), (9, 727)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 727.

questions.question: In a row of 49 students, Ravi is 10th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 49 − 10 + 1 = 40.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 2²…6². Next is 7² = 49.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 6, so 15 + 6 = 21.

questions.question: If TREE is coded as VTGG, how is LAMP coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to LAMP gives NCOR.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 6:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 6:00 the angle is 6 × 30° = 180°.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km East and then 15 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 11 + 6 × 3.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 11 × 6 − 3 = 66 − 3 = 63.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 16 × 2 = 32.

questions.question: Complete the series: A, E, I, M, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is Q.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 11, 19, 8, 3
questions.explanation: 11, 19, 3 are prime numbers; 8 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 12th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 12th letter from the right is the 15th from the left = O.
